# Bounded AI coding task

Task ID: TASK-[ID]
Status: specified / approved / in_progress / blocked / in_review / complete
Implementation authorized by/date: [required]

## Goal

One sentence describing the observable outcome.

## Read first

AGENTS.md, CURRENT_STATE.md, relevant requirement/spec/test sections, and applicable audit findings.

## Dependencies and baseline

Verified prerequisite tasks, current revision, known failures. Do not infer approval from a backlog entry.

## Allowed scope

Files/modules allowed to change:
Files/services explicitly excluded:
No dependency/provider/deployment change without approval.

## Plan and contract

Inputs/outputs, errors, authorization, revisions, jobs/artifacts, limits, cost and data-handling implications.

## Acceptance tests

Commands/assertions/fixtures to run; expected outcome; tests requiring staging or explicit paid budget. Include failure/recovery paths.

## Approval checkpoint

Present planned changes and uncertainty before editing. Stop if scope, rights, privacy, or budget assumptions change.

## Completion report

Actual diff; exact commands/results; not-run checks; spend/provider usage; remaining issues; rollback; documentation updates; next task. Use the session handoff template.
